name: remove-positions
description:
The first characters of a phrase, or the last ones (remove and extract).

count: how many characters.
last: the last characters; by default the first.

remove gives an empty cell when the phrase has that many characters or fewer; extract then gives the whole phrase.

remove-positions removes what the matcher finds from the working column.

Example: semkit read core.csv remove-positions 2 write out.csv

options.name: --last
options.description: the last characters; by default the first.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: COUNT
arguments.description: how many characters. The same as --count COUNT.
